name: RMSprop
description: PyTorch RMSprop factory with alpha, eps, momentum, centered, weight decay, and backend option forwarding.

examples.title: Train a tabular classifier with RMSprop
examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth

root = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="topologies-rmsprop-")
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    label = int(features[0] + features[1] > 0)
    return {"features": features, "labels": label}

dataset = synth.Spec("rmsprop-classification", generator=samples, size=24, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="train")
val = dataset.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="val", like=train)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, val, recipe="tabular-classify", optimizer="rmsprop", max_epochs=1, batch_size=8, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
result = trainer.evaluate(val)
